title: Accounts Receivable Standard for In-Place Home Resale Fees: Payments and Credits
content:
**Accounts receivable standard — In-Place Home Resale files.**

- Fees billed upfront are paid through the package's accepted payment channels and are due the package's upfront-fee due period in calendar days after they are charged.
- A payment is applied to the oldest open charge first.
- A credit restores exactly one charge, or the part of it named by its credit reason, and never more than the charge.
- A charge posted in error is credited in full as a billing-error credit; a fee correctly charged under the In-Place Home Resale terms is never credited as a courtesy.

## Applying a payment (hypothetical file)

| Open charge | Charged on | Amount | After a payment of 800.00 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Package service fee | 4 May | 795.00 | cleared |
| Initial inspection charge | 9 May | 125.00 | 5.00 applied; 120.00 still open |

The oldest open charge, the 795.00 package service fee, takes the payment first; the remaining 5.00 goes to the next oldest charge.

## Credits (hypothetical cases)

| Case | Credit |
|---|---|
| A 45.00 charge posted twice for the same month in error | the duplicate is credited in full, 45.00, as a billing-error credit |
| A correctly charged 295.00 withdrawal fee the seller asks to have forgiven | no credit: a correct fee is never credited as a courtesy |
| A credit asked for of 150.00 against a 125.00 charge | at most 125.00: a credit never exceeds the charge it restores |
